subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a durable wake remain bound to the session generation that created it, or intentionally surface as a `systemEvent` in the current canonical session after a reset?
rationale: The existing queue fences `agentTurn` continuations with `expectedSessionId`, while this PR deliberately omits that fence for wake system events; source inspection and tests can prove either implementation, but cannot determine the intended conversation-boundary policy.

options.title: Fence wake generation
options.body: Bind each queued wake to the originating session generation and skip or expose it for operator recovery when that generation no longer matches.

options.title: Use current session
options.body: Define durable wake ownership as session-key scoped and intentionally allow a pre-reset obligation to surface in the current session generation.

options.title: Defer final handoff
options.body: Keep durable wakes inspectable but pending until a later owner-approved policy determines how reset boundaries should be handled.

recommendation.title: Fence wake generation
recommendation.body: Bind each queued wake to the originating session generation and skip or expose it for operator recovery when that generation no longer matches.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged session-delivery queue work defines the closest existing generation and recovery contract for this decision.
